# Unit 3 week 6 — Teacher marking guide
20 marks; analytic draft guide, no annual weighting assigned. Award for equivalent correct logic; incidental formatting should not erase demonstrated knowledge.
1 (5): inheritance declaration 1; base initialisation 1; validated type excluding bool1; inclusive 0–128 boundaries 1; independent stored field 1.
2 (3): correct below 16 branch 1; correct exact messages 1; query remains non-mutating 1.
3 (4): setter type/range validation 2; invalid state unchanged 1; inherited stock behaviour retained 1.
4 (3): mixed report through shared call 1; successful/excessive lending outcomes 1; explains subtype method selection 1.
5 (5): expected and actual 15/16 results 1; rejected 129 with unchanged state 1; valid/rejected lending evidence 1; super initialises same object's base state 1; kit composition explanation 1.
Storage 15=>Free some storage,16=>Check the screen;129 raises ValueError, leaving prior storage. Total 2 lend 1=>True/available 1, lend 2=>False/available 1. Generic Equipment preparation is Check the item before use. Output report T01: Free some storage and E03: Check the item before use. If multiple tasks fail because of one earlier fault, assess demonstrated later intent consistently with school marking policy. Authenticate student work through supervised evidence.
